mapper.sql: SELECT id, name, description, monitor_type_id, trigger_mode, cron_expression, script_type, script_content, silence_minutes, sustain_seconds, is_enabled, last_run_time, last_run_result, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alarm_strategy_hazard_point WHERE strategy_id = alarm_strategy.id) AS scope_count FROM alarm_strategy
mapper.select: WHERE del_flag = 0 AND is_enabled = 1 AND trigger_mode = #{triggerMode}
WHERE del_flag = 0 AND name = #{name} AND id != #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarm_strategy (name, description, monitor_type_id, trigger_mode, cron_expression, script_type, script_content, silence_minutes, sustain_seconds, is_enabled, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{monitorTypeId}, #{triggerMode}, #{cronExpression}, #{scriptType}, #{scriptContent}, #{silenceMinutes}, #{sustainSeconds}, #{isEnabled}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT dhp.hazard_point_id FROM device_hazard_point dhp JOIN device_sensor ds ON ds.device_id = dhp.device_id WHERE ds.monitor_type_id = #{monitorTypeId} AND ds.del_flag = 0 AND ds.status = 1
